name: [UPD] Protect the House 🏠💥
desc:
[UPDATE] ☀️ New Map and more

Protect your home and your friends from the evil gunmen mafia by engaging in a really awesome gunfight combat with weapons like no other roblox experience. Rig your home with upgrades like a nuke that can be purchased from the lobby and survive countless of waves of enemies, minibosses and bosses. Make sure to always protect your money making operation! 

How many days can you survive?

👍 Like and faveourite the game for more updates ⭐
💵 Join our group for 150 starter cash!
❗The old stolen games have been taken down and we are the ORIGINAL version. We hope you enjoy the game and we have lots of things planned for the future!



Inspired by: Protect the House 🏠💥, Skinwalkers👀, Survive Overnight in a Mega Store, Survive A Week In The Woods, DANGEROUS NIGHT [FURNISH THE BUNKER], Defend the House from Zombies


Developed with ❤️ by Fronts Studios 
Tags: Defend, Protect, House, House Defence, Survival, Survive or die, Survive 7 days.
